data.description:
We at Alimama are thrilled to offer our customers freshly made mochi donuts that are sure to satisfy your sweet tooth. Our donuts come in a variety of flavors such as cereal donut, burlee donut, and sesame donut. Each donut is made with the finest ingredients and is sure to be a hit with your guests.

In addition to our mochi donuts, we also offer milk tea boba cream puffs that are a fusion of popular Asian drink and pastry. Our cream puffs are light and airy, filled with a delicious cream that is sure to satisfy your sweet tooth. We believe that our offerings are unique and will provide a memorable experience for you and your guests.

We are grateful for the opportunity to share our story with you and hope that you will continue to visit us and enjoy our offerings. Thank you for choosing Alimama as your go-to place to unwind and find joy.

data.name: Club A Steakhouse
data.ranking: #7 of 11,772 Restaurants in New York City
data.description: Established in 2008. Bruno Selimaj was born and raised in a small village on the Northern Albanian/Montenegrin border and began his life as simple farmer. But at the tender age of 18 and with his parents blessing, he embarked on a journey to America in search of new life. In an Albanian household, it is tradition that a guest is treated with the utmost respect and as a member of the family. Bruno brought these core family values to his restaurant and Bruno Selimaj's life defines true restaurant hospitality. In December 2007, Bruno closed his legendary restaurant after 30 years with a new idea and a continuing passion to strive to be the best. He re-opened his famed restaurant as Club A, a modern American steakhouse in the same location. His new venture manages to encompass the characteristics of a traditional steakhouse and new world modernism. His latest accomplishment has established Bruno as one of New York's legendary restaurateurs.

data.name: The Standard Grill
data.ranking: #14 of 11,772 Restaurants in New York City
data.description: A neighborhood staple, The Standard Grill is classic New York blending traditional steakhouse with New American cuisine. Our kitchen utilizes the freshest local ingredients from the extensive fresh daily raw bar and dry aged steaks to the classic Standard Burger and shoestring fries. The classics updated and perfected. Evoking the feeling of old New York the raucous main dining room features a copper penny tile floor, cozy curved booths and a barrel vaulted ceiling. The front room and street side bistro is a bright tiled space with café curtains and a white oak bar, the perfect place to try a specialty cocktail or fresh oysters and charcuterie.
